about_short_description.short_description: Gainful is a personalized sports nutrition company that offers subscriptions to its Hydration line of electrolyte drink mixes.

product.name: Personalized Protein Blends
product.description: Customized protein powders tailored to individual goals and dietary needs, available in various formulations including whey, plant-based, collagen, and ketogenic blends.

product.name: Flavor Packets
product.description: Individual flavor packets that can be added to unflavored protein powders or other foods to customize taste without additives.

product.name: Personalized Hydration Electrolyte Drink Mixes
product.description: Single-serve electrolyte drink mixes formulated to support hydration with key electrolytes and low sugar content.

product.name: Personalized Pre-Workout Supplements
product.description: Pre-workout powders with varying caffeine and creatine levels to enhance workout energy, endurance, and recovery.

product.name: Daily Performance Greens
product.description: A greens powder blend containing organic vegetables, fibers, adaptogens, and antioxidants to support gut health, immunity, and cognitive function.

product.name: Creatine Monohydrate Supplement
product.description: A creatine monohydrate powder supplement to support muscle strength, power, recovery, and cognitive benefits.
